[1/1] Plan: context meter: usage summary gains the latest billed request, contextOf resolves the model window from the catalog or the provider's own model list, GET /api/usage returns context, status bar shows ctx percent in ok, warn and bad colours with a slash compact hint

impact_assessment.why: Users could not tell how full the context window was or when to compact; Claude Code shows it
impact_assessment.benefits: At-a-glance awareness of context pressure and a timely nudge to compact before quality or cost suffers
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive last and context fields on GET /api/usage, existing fields unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: read-only aggregation; state: none, derived from llm.usage events

[1/1] Plan: fix four defects found reviewing the working tree against the single starting commit: mentions bypassed the secrets policy, the path jail ignored symlinks and junctions, deny rules were dodged by path or whitespace or case spelling, and image blobs were written non-atomically and trusted forever

impact_assessment.why: Review of the uncommitted tree found security and crash-safety gaps in features added this session; a deny rule that can be spelled around and a jail that links walk through are worse than no rule
impact_assessment.benefits: Secrets never reach a provider through a mention, links cannot leak files from outside the workspace, deny rules hold, and a crash cannot leave a corrupt image that is served forever
impact_assessment.risks: contract: resolveInside now refuses link escapes so a workspace that relies on an outward symlink loses that access, rules now match normalised spellings; dependency: none; concurrency: image write uses temp, fsync and rename; state: blob files are verified by content hash on load
impact_assessment.mitigation: Eight failing tests written first and confirmed failing for the right reasons, the existing 305 server and unit tests still pass, realpath cost measured with interleaved paired runs, fail closed when a real path cannot be resolved
